name: agentic-plugins
description: Pedro Camara Junior's Claude Code plugins — agentic developer workflows.

plugins.name: visual-parity
plugins.description: Visual parity loop for UI migrations. Compare a legacy reference URL with a new tree, then iterate CSS until they match human-eye.

plugins.name: debug
plugins.description: Hypothesis-driven runtime debugging (Cursor Debug Mode style). Instruments your code with self-cleaning log statements, captures runtime evidence through a local collector while the bug is reproduced, applies an evidence-backed fix, and asks you to verify.
